meta.title: Adding a product auto-adds a new row; typing narrows the product search
gaps: Assert that the product dropdown options are narrowed to the typed text.
Assert that selecting the product automatically adds a new empty row beneath it.
Assert that the row count increases by one relative to its pre-selection value.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that the product dropdown options are narrowed to the typed text.; Assert that selecting the product automatically adds a new empty row beneath it.; Assert that the row count increases by one relative to its pre-selection value.

steps.note: Open the single-stage event setup screen.
Configure the single-stage event with a pricing event type so product line items can be added.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Apply a pricing template before adding the product.
Use the catalog's product-add flow to add one line item; this is the closest available action to typing a product search and selecting a result.
Assert that one product line item was added.
Assert that the pricing sheet rendered after the product was added.
